definition: ready because you organized everything in advance
description: A boy walks through a crowded school hallway carrying a giant expedition backpack with ice axes, a rolled sleeping mat and a tower of books stacked on top; amazed classmates watch as he proudly declares himself ready, then tips backward onto his sleeping roll to rest.
transcript: Did you come here to sleep? I am a prepared student.
